newsitem.title: CHINA: China offshore oil output 15 mln tonnes in 1996.
newsitem.headline: China offshore oil output 15 mln tonnes in 1996.

text.p: China's offshore oil output rose six million tonnes to 15.0078 million in 1996 compared with the previous year, the China Offshore Oil Press newspaper said in an edition available on Sunday.
China had said earlier it expected offshore output to hit 14 million tonnes in 1996.
Offshore output of natural gas reached 2.68 billion cubic metres in 1996, soaring by 2.3 billion cubic metres compared with 1995, the newspaper said.
The newspaper attributed the increase in production of oil and natural gas to the exploitation of new fields as well as a rise in output from existing fields.
All but two of China's offshore oil and gas fields had already reached their middle and late stages of development, but these were now capable of stable output, it said.
The newspaper estimated the year-on-year increase in oil production for 1996 at 80 percent, with average daily production of 410,000 tonnes and reaching as high as 550,000 tonnes a day.
Revenue of the China National Offshore Oil Corp was estimated at 3.5 billion yuan for 1996, spurred by rising crude prices, the newspaper said.
